data.text:
@jinpingxidebaba @xiaocao Grok Bot是xAI（现属SpaceXAI）的常时在线AI agent产品。每个用户有持久云电脑，Bot可自主登录工具、跑任务、团队协作，24/7工作，类似同事。

和OpenAI dots高度接近：都是带专用云电脑的always-on agent，能后台推进工作。Grok Bot更早推出、支持多Bot组队，入口价更低（从约30刀起）。

grok ai agents are moving past the chat box. xai turned grok bot into persistent, always-on agent teams that run on a shared cloud computer even after you close your laptop and walk away. https://t.co/I1KX3n8Fek

note_tweet.text: Not quite. OpenClaw runs on hardware you control with models you supply. Grok Bot has its own persistent cloud computer that keeps working while yours is off, no local setup needed. Same general idea of an always-on agent, different approach to where it lives and how much you manage.
